rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares
positions.catalyst: Wed Oct 14: ASML Q3 — record EPS/margin and FY guide nudged up to €44-45B, but revenue €11.66B missed USD consensus and shares are -0.8% pre-mkt (1704.8 vs 1717.8) with the selloff spreading to memory: SNDK -2.4%, MU -1.3%, SOXL -2.1%, SMH -0.4%. SOXS +2.3% pre-mkt (38.27 vs 37.42) — well under the no-chase line.
positions.driver: Third straight day of semis distribution with a fresh bellwether catalyst (ASML revenue miss) on top of CXMT DDR5 / AI-financing worries; broad market flat-to-up (SPY +0.2%, IWM +0.3%) so it's a sector-specific short, not beta. Hot-headline CPI (consensus 3.6-3.7% y/y, Fed hiked in Sept) leans against high-multiple chips. Beat BTC-USD/BITX (flat ~83.3k, no catalyst), BAC/FAS (BAC -3% pre-mkt on $1.2B Treasury penalty, reports 6:45am ET — binary, unknown print), BABA (+1.5% Qwen glasses, small 1x move), SQQQ (diluted). 3x kept on multi-day, multi-region confirmation; -10% hard stop caps damage.
positions.risks: Yesterday's identical setup faded — SOXS gapped to 40.9 pre-mkt then closed 37.42 as dips got bought; repeat is the main risk. 8:30am ET CPI is binary: a soft core (≤0.2% m/m) could spark a broad risk-on squeeze in semis. Bank earnings (BAC/MS/WFC) can swing tape; 3x daily decay. Hard stop 34.44 (-10%).
